verdict.rationale: Pulley documents e-signature collection for board members and investors on SAFEs (pulley-docs-9) and lists 'board management' under its compliance product (pulley-docs-19), plus standard equity document templates (pulley-docs-21), suggesting some support for routing approvals for signature. However, there is no explicit documentation of drafting board consents or stockholder approvals specifically, nor evidence they are archived and linked against the transactions they authorize. Missing for 10: explicit board consent/stockholder approval drafting workflow, archival linkage to specific transactions, and independent confirmation of this governance workflow.
